name: Open Images V7
description: Open Images V7 is a massive computer vision dataset of approximately 9 million images annotated with image-level labels, object bounding boxes, object segmentation masks, visual relationships, and localized narratives. Version 7 expands the corpus with 66.4 million point labels on 1.4 million images across 5,827 categories, providing rich supervision for object detection, instance segmentation, and point-level localization.
